n8n, HubSpot, Python, JS, Google Sheets, DigitalOcean, Microsoft 365, Slack, Qwilr, Xero, DocuSeal, Anthropic Claude API

Live n8n automation workshops for technical professionals. Target: €15-20K/month in 3 years.

- Kay Steinberg: BKA, A10 April 2026, liaison pool Feb 2026, diplomatic posting 2028

- Always complete solutions, never partial snippets
- Same language she writes in (English or Portuguese)
- If venting, help think through it practically
- Honesty over being spared the reality", "messages": [' + msgs + ']}';
})() }}
